OIML R-76 Math Engine: Compliant Test (PASS)

Clause 3.5.3 Changeover Point Method Validation
OIML R-76 COMPLIANT

Automated evaluation using standard changeover point: P = I + 0.5e - dL. For Load L=1000g, I=1000g, dL=0.2g, e=1g: P = 1000.3g and corrected error Ec = +0.3g within MPE ±1g.

  • Formula: P = I + 0.5e - dL (Changeover point)
  • Corrected Error: Ec = (P - L) - E0 = +0.3g
  • MPE Limit: ±1.0g → Status: COMPLIANT (PASS)
Compliant Load Point: Result badge marked COMPLIANT (PASS) with live formula breakdown

OIML R-76 Math Engine: Error Out-of-Spec (FAIL)

Immediate Non-Compliance Detection & Defective Scale Alert
DEFECT DETECTION

Simulated high mechanical wear or sensor fault: Indication I=5025g for 1000g load. The engine calculates Ec = +4025.3g, immediately rejecting the test as NON-COMPLIANT.

  • Automated defect flagging prevents erroneous certification
  • Excessive error Ec = +4025.3g breaches MPE boundary
  • Highlights failure reason for recalibration dispatch
Non-compliant Detection: High-error point flagged with NON-COMPLIANT (FAIL) badge
